algebraic variety over $\mathbb C$
([[def-classical-algebraic-prevariety-regular-maps-and-varieties]]), regarded as
a topological space with its analytic topology
([[def-analytic-topology-and-finite-smooth-algebraic-stratifications]]), and
let $k$ be a field. Write $\operatorname{Sh}_k(X)$ for the category of sheaves
of $k$-vector spaces and $k$-linear morphisms
([[def-sheaf-on-topological-space]],
[[def-presheaf-of-groups-rings-modules]], [[def-module-on-ringed-space]]); it is
an abelian category ([[thm-abelian-sheaves-form-abelian-category]]), so its
bounded derived category $D^b(\operatorname{Sh}_k(X))$ is defined with the
conventions of [[def-derived-category-of-an-abelian-category]], under the
standing smallness hypothesis recorded there.

1. $A$ is **cohomologically bounded**: $H^j(A)=0$ for $|j|$ sufficiently large;
   and
2. $A$ is **algebraically constructible**: there exists a finite smooth
   algebraic stratification with the frontier condition $\mathfrak S$ of $X$
   ([[def-analytic-topology-and-finite-smooth-algebraic-stratifications]]) such
   that for every stratum $S\in\mathfrak S$ and every integer $j$ the
   restriction $H^j(A)|_S$ is locally constant of finite rank
   ([[def-locally-constant-sheaf-of-finite-rank]]).

Assume the Axiom of Choice inherited from the supplied injective-resolution six-functor construction. Let $f:Y\to X$ be a proper surjective morphism of finite-type complex algebraic varieties, and let $F\in D^b_c(X;k)$ for a field $k$. Write $Y_p=Y\times_X\cdots\times_XY$ with $p+1$ factors, $f_p:Y_p\to X$, and $F_p=f_p^*F$. In the analytic topology of [[def-analytic-topology-and-finite-smooth-algebraic-stratifications]] the natural augmented derived Cech map is a quasi-isomorphism:
$$F\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Tot}_{p\geq0}Rf_{p*}F_p.$$
Here totalization is the normalized or unnormalized alternating-face total supplied by the simplicial-derived construction. There is one fixed lower cochain bound; consequently its diagonals are finite in every degree. The claim commutes with arbitrary algebraic base change and coefficient morphisms. In particular $R\Gamma(X,F)\simeq\operatorname{Tot}_pR\Gamma(Y_p,F_p)$. Individual fibers of $f$ need not be cohomologically acyclic, connected, or smooth.

Assume the Axiom of Choice as inherited from the supplied six-functor resolutions. Let $X_\bullet\to X$ be an augmented simplicial finite-type complex algebraic variety ([[def-simplicial-object-and-simplicial-commutative-ring]], [[def-analytic-topology-and-finite-smooth-algebraic-stratifications]]). Assume $X_0\to X$ is proper surjective and, for each $p>0$, $X_p\to(\operatorname{cosk}_{p-1}\operatorname{sk}_{p-1}X_\bullet)_p$ is proper surjective over $X$, where $\operatorname{sk}_{p-1}$ restricts to levels through $p-1$, $\operatorname{cosk}_{p-1}$ is its right Kan extension formed by finite matching limits, and the target is the matching object. Such an object is a proper hypercover; no smoothness or fiber acyclicity is assumed. For $F\in D^b_c(X;k)$ over a field, and $a_p:X_p\to X$, the augmentation gives
$$F\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Tot}_{p\geq0}Ra_{p*}a_p^*F,\qquad R\Gamma(X,F)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Tot}_{p\geq0}R\Gamma(X_p,a_p^*F).$$
There is a natural strongly convergent spectral sequence $E_1^{p,q}=H^q(X_p,a_p^*F)\Rightarrow H^{p+q}(X,F)$. If $F$ has cochain lower bound $a$, every diagonal $p+q=m$ is finite; degree $m$ and its differential are determined by levels through $p=m-a+1$. All proper-hypercover refinements induce the same comparison via the base object; any two such hypercovers have a proper common refinement. For $F=k_X$, $a=0$, this is the first-quadrant spectral sequence required for smooth-projective hyperresolutions.

$Z_\bullet$ is a family $F=(F_p)_{p\ge0}$ in which $F_p$ is a sheaf of

the identity and composition identities; a morphism $F\to G$ is a levelwise
family of $k$-linear sheaf maps commuting with the structure morphisms.
Kernels and cokernels are formed levelwise (cokernels after sheafification of
the presheaf cokernel) and exactness is checked levelwise, so the category
$\operatorname{Sh}_k(Z_\bullet)$ of simplicial sheaves is abelian; under AC it
carries explicit coinduced injective resolutions and a bounded derived
category, with the conventions recorded in
[[lem-locally-split-cech-nerves-give-derived-cartesian-sheaf-descent]], whose
bounded-below injective model uses
[[lem-field-module-sheaves-have-injective-derived-models]]. Write
$D^b(\operatorname{Sh}_k(Z_\bullet))$ for that bounded derived category
([[def-derived-category-of-an-abelian-category]]), with its ordinary shift
$[1]$ and cone triangles.
